candidate.user_submission: Pikin na 18 months old. E get cough or e dey breathe with wahala, and e no get diarrhoea. E no get ear problem. E no get fever. Dem count how e dey breathe for full one minute, and e no calm when dem dey check am. E dey breathe 35 times for one minute. For the cough, e don tey for 3 days. Dem no see chest dey go inside, and e no get stridor when e calm. E no dey wheeze, e no get recurrent wheeze, and dem no use pulse oximeter. E no dey convulse now, e never get convulsion before, e no dey lethargic and e dey conscious. E fit drink or suck breast. E no dey vomit everything.
